texts.name: District AI
texts.subtitle: AI receptionist for your line
texts.promotionalText: One Canadian provider for the whole business line, now on your Mac. District AI answers your calls, and your team picks up from the inbox, the call log and the calendar.
texts.description:
One Canadian provider for the whole business line.

District AI for Mac brings your team's inbox, calls, contacts, meeting rooms and bookings to the desktop, in one window with a sidebar.

Distronode is a Canadian telecommunications company. It runs a growing business's phone line end to end, from one provider: the number, the calls and texts, the receptionist that answers, and the desk behind it.

One line for the whole company.
Every call and every text thread lands in the same inbox, beside the caller's record, so whoever picks it up next knows what was said.
Read and answer conversations with search, drafts and image attachments.
Keep several workspaces under one login, each with its own members and roles.

Take and place calls on your Mac.
A call handed to you rings in a small window that stays above your other apps, with Answer, Decline, Mute and Hang up. Close the window and District AI stays in the menu bar and keeps ringing; Open at Login starts it when you log in. Once you quit it, a call still arrives as a notification with a ring sound.
Dial from your Mac, with the country each number rings shown beside it, and call back recent callers in one click.
Choose the microphone and speaker for calls, in the call window or in Settings.

District AI answers, and does the work after hello.
It greets every caller in a natural voice, answers from the hours and services you give it, and books straight into Google Calendar or Microsoft 365 while the caller is on the line.
When a caller needs someone, it transfers to a named person on your team. It speaks English and Canadian French, plus Spanish, German, Dutch and Italian, in a voice you choose.

Every call written up.
Each call's details show the caller, what they asked for, an AI summary and the transcript, as the call ends. The call log and contacts are tables you can sort by any column.

Meet in Rooms.
Start or rejoin a meeting room with video, share a guest link, and read past meetings' minutes. A contact's Video call button sends them a guest link and opens the room.

The desk behind the line.
District Scheduling is included on every plan: a booking page at your own address, on the calendar you already use. Manage event types, hours, bookings, calendar connections and your team from the Mac.

Made for the Mac.
Menu commands and keyboard shortcuts for new messages, new contacts, search and refresh, the unread count on the Dock icon, and notifications for new messages and calls.

We publish the parts most vendors keep vague.
Distronode Corporation is federally incorporated in Toronto. Your workspace lives in Montreal, Virginia, Frankfurt or Singapore, and a Canadian number we issue is answered in Montreal.
We publish every company that touches your data and every border it crosses, with a dated change log and an hourly status page. We keep a transcript and a summary of each call, not the audio.
The receptionist and every email work in Canadian French, and the app is in English and Canadian French.
